name: Obara Group Incorporated
summary: Obara Group Incorporated engages in the manufacture and sale of welder, polisher, and electrical components in Japan and internationally. The company offers resistance welding systems for the automotive industry and arc welding tools for shipbuilding and construction industries. It also provides polishing equipment, cleaners, and lasers, as well as consumable sets, such as slurries, abrasives, carriers, pads, and plates. In addition, the company offers electrical components, such as insulation, connecting, and fixing components used in the power infrastructure. Obara Group Incorporated was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Yamato, Japan.
